errorCodes.meaning: No such DID is held by this VTA, or the caller cannot reach its context.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

daemonCleanupError.description: Set when the VTA removed its own record but the hosting server did not confirm removal of the published log. **The DID may still resolve.** This is a partial success reported as a success, and a consumer MUST surface it rather than treating the deletion as complete.

deleted.description: Whether the VTA removed its record. A successful response carrying `false` means it declined.
